notablePrerequisites:
There are at least two Elves on the battlefield.
Rex does not have summoning sickness.
Priest of Titania and Pili-Pala exiled with a brain counter on them.
description:
Activate Rex using Priest of Titania's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Rex using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
